from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
lane=Path.cwd();plan={'url':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/1702.06444','routes':['336276'],'destination':'sources/heaps.pdf','source_identity':'Basdevant Singh Almost-sure asymptotic primary PDF','purpose':'Read actual heap sequence law and proof to test interval-limit subsumption'}
